Building = axis-aligned rectangular BLOCKS (cx,cz centre; w along x; d along z), level 0 (ground) or 1 (upper). Same-level blocks may touch but not overlap. A level-1 block must sit ≥60% over level-0 blocks (cantilever ≤3 m). Two storeys = stack blocks.
STAGE 1 - ARCHITECT: return the design direction only (identity, hierarchy of masses, roof language, entrance, outdoor living, landscape, palette). No geometry. Palette walls, accent, roof and deck must each be one of ivory, limestone, timber, bronze, sage. palette.roofColor must be supplied as null when unspecified; otherwise it must be a six-digit hexadecimal color such as #B65A36, never a material description or color name. Describe terracotta clay tiles in roofLanguage; use roofColor for their hex color.
